 As a Quality Assurance Test Engineer, you are an integral part of one of our scrum teams and will work for a specific client. You test the work created by the team and provide testing reports. Testing is done manually and automated (code scan and regression testing).
Experience in the domain is a plus, but we consider attention to detail, energy and persistence to be a great starting point in this field.
You will receive training, organized learning sessions with outside specialists and we will get you on track for an ISTQB certification.
 Skills We Appreciate
Fluent English with good written and verbal communication skills
PHP, HTML, CSS development experience
University degree in Computer Science or Engineering
Be able to eat large amounts of crispy strips
 Working for CamelWeb is a great and growing experience. You will work alongside a smart, laid-back team and deliver on compelling projects for top brands. As a CamelWeb employee, you receive a salary that matches your experience and we continue to invest in growing you as a professional. Our goal is to transform this opportunity into a successful IT career.
Get in touch with us to learn more about the CamelWeb team and projects.
